Package aor.proj3t.daos.interfaces

Interface EvaluationDAO

All Superinterfaces:
BasicDAO<Evaluation,Long>
All Known Implementing Classes:
EvaluationDAOimpl
public interface EvaluationDAO extends BasicDAO<Evaluation,Long>
Data Access Object interface for Evaluation entity operations.

This interface extends BasicDAO to provide comprehensive operations for managing employee evaluations within the performance evaluation system. Evaluations represent the assessment records between evaluators and employees during specific evaluation cycles.

Key features include:

  • Querying evaluations by evaluator, cycle, and date ranges
  • Status-based filtering and counting operations
  • Bulk operations for closing completed evaluations
  • Advanced filtering using EvaluationFilter
  • Performance monitoring and reporting capabilities

  • Method Details

    • findByEvaluator

      List<Evaluation> findByEvaluator(Long evaluatorId)
      Retrieves all evaluations performed by a specific evaluator.

      This method finds all evaluation records where the specified user acts as the evaluator. Useful for generating evaluator workload reports and performance tracking.

      Parameters:
      evaluatorId - The unique identifier of the evaluator. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of evaluations performed by the specified evaluator, or an empty list if no evaluations are found

    • findByCycleId

      List<Evaluation> findByCycleId(Long cycleId)
      Retrieves all evaluations belonging to a specific evaluation cycle.

      This method finds all evaluation records that are part of the specified evaluation cycle. Essential for cycle management and progress tracking.

      Parameters:
      cycleId - The unique identifier of the evaluation cycle. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of evaluations for the specified cycle, or an empty list if no evaluations are found

    • findByDateRange

      List<Evaluation> findByDateRange(Instant startDate, Instant endDate)
      Retrieves evaluations created within a specific date range.

      This method finds all evaluations that were created between the specified start and end dates (inclusive). Useful for reporting and analytics over specific time periods.

      Parameters:
      startDate - The start date of the range (inclusive). Must not be null.
      endDate - The end date of the range (inclusive). Must not be null and must be after startDate.
      Returns:
      A List of evaluations created within the specified date range, or an empty list if no evaluations are found

    • closeAllCompletedEvaluations

      int closeAllCompletedEvaluations()
      Closes all evaluations that have been completed but not yet closed.

      This bulk operation updates the status of all evaluations that are in a completed state to closed. This is typically used during cycle closure or administrative cleanup operations.

      Returns:
      The number of evaluations that were successfully closed

    • getEvaluationsByFilters

      List<Evaluation> getEvaluationsByFilters(EvaluationFilter filters)
      Retrieves evaluations based on complex filtering criteria.

      This method provides advanced querying capabilities using a filter object that can specify multiple criteria such as status, date ranges, evaluator, and other evaluation properties.

      Parameters:
      filters - The filter criteria to apply. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of evaluations matching the filter criteria, or an empty list if no matches are found

    • countUnclosedEvaluationsByCycleId

      Integer countUnclosedEvaluationsByCycleId(Long cycleId)
      Counts unclosed evaluations within a specific evaluation cycle.

      This method provides a count of evaluations that are not yet closed within the specified cycle. Useful for tracking cycle completion progress.

      Parameters:

    • findByEvaluatedAndStatusIn

      List<Evaluation> findByEvaluatedAndStatusIn(User evaluated, List<EvaluationStatus> statuses)
      Retrieves evaluations for a specific evaluated user filtered by status.

      This method finds all evaluations where the specified user is being evaluated and the evaluation has one of the specified statuses. Useful for employee self-service portals and performance tracking.

      Parameters:
      evaluated - The user being evaluated. Must not be null.
      statuses - The list of evaluation statuses to filter by. Must not be null or empty.
      Returns:
      A List of evaluations for the specified user with matching statuses, or an empty list if no matches are found
